limitations: Concatenated Word text checks do not establish whitespace layout, numbering restart behavior, pagination or styling equivalence.
Syntect and lowlight use different grammars and token/theme mappings.
Highlighted TypeScript output replaces some spaces with NBSP; Rust keeps ordinary spaces. Equality checks for that case normalize only NBSP to space.
Raw HTML underline differs: TypeScript prints <u> tags literally; Rust removes the tags and retains their text without underline. Prose timings use the shared ++underline++ syntax instead.
This chart's decoded pixels match exactly; PNG encoding differs. Other chart definitions were not checked for pixel equality.
Word/LibreOffice rendering and browser DOM execution were not tested.
